description: This file defines two internal sealed classes, WellKnownCodecDescription and WellKnownCopierDescription, used for describing codecs and copiers with references to their underlying types and specific codec/copier types within the Orleans code generation project.

classes.name: WellKnownCodecDescription
classes.description: Represents a description for a well-known codec, including its underlying type and codec type.

classes.name: WellKnownCopierDescription
classes.description: Represents a description for a well-known copier, including its underlying type and copier type.

methods.name: WellKnownCodecDescription
methods.description: Constructor that initializes the underlying type and codec type.

methods.name: WellKnownCopierDescription
methods.description: Constructor that initializes the underlying type and copier type.
